Jo (2026-11-03 ~02:05Z, input in-mw01ww9xf3gx8s; Jo ~6:05 PM PST 11/2: "yes and i want it done ASAP"): open a normal-stakes as2 workload and start it now. Goal: finish switching on land-first, which runs fast checks before merge and the full suite on main after (PR #369; Jo's 10/27 ruling). Readiness report with receipts: /Users/jowolff/agent-scratch/agent-system-2.0/land-first/READINESS-2026-11-02.md.

Lane work:
1. Make as2-hosted green on Linux. It fails 12 tests in ledger/test/install.test.ts, ledger/test/file-links-install.test.ts and surface/test/doctor-cli.test.ts.
2. Fix the main-suite flakes, so land-first's revert-on-red never reverts a good PR: 12 of the 13 red main runs since 10/28 passed when rerun alone, and 10 of them named surface/test/as2test.test.ts. Fix only the flakes main runs actually hit. Don't duplicate the test-timing cause batches (/Users/jowolff/agent-scratch/agent-system-2.0/wl-mvtueivmiujnom/PLAN.md:72-120); those belong to the test-timing follow-up, which isn't open yet.
3. Run the proof Jo deferred (migration/items/train-land-first.md, the "Before Jo says land-first agent-system-2.0 on" list): dispatch as2-fast against a real PR head through the verified ref, measure the Linux seconds of the fast sets for the last 20 code landings, and keep the receipts.

Not lane work: the install that moves lane tools to the verified root (as2test-setup.sh, then install.sh --control-root=verified) is Jo's to run, through Plumb's update sequence once lanes are idle. The on word (`land-first agent-system-2.0 on`) is Jo's alone; the lane never writes it.

Known context: with land-first off, the runner preflight only records refusals (Plumb, 2026-11-02). The verified bundle's SOURCE file lags promotions that change no SOURCE input (test-runner.ts:2405-2406, 2463); expect refused-but-recorded preflight rows, which are not this workload's failure.

Build lanes run on anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 (Jo's model rule; the profile default).

## How it fails
- **Any proof fails** (as2-hosted still red on Linux, a flake that reproduces, the as2-fast dispatch refusing or erroring, or fast-set timings missing or over budget). It surfaces as the failing CI run, test-run row or dispatch log. Recovery: land-first stays off; the lane names the failure and its receipt to Jo as a question with options. Bound: two fix rounds per item, then the question.
- **A Linux-only failure needs a platform change outside the three named test files** (install paths, file links, doctor CLI assumptions). It surfaces in the hosted run's log. Recovery: fix in the code under test only if it's a real Linux bug; otherwise make the test platform-correct. Never skip or quarantine a test. Bound: one question to Jo if the change touches install behavior on the Mac.
- **A flake can't be reproduced** from the main-run history. It surfaces as a solo rerun passing repeatedly. Recovery: record the run ids and the solo-rerun evidence and leave it unfixed with a named reason; no retry-until-green, no timeout raise. Bound: 20 isolated runs per suspect file.
- **A flake fix overlaps a test-timing cause batch.** It surfaces when the cause matches PLAN.md:72-120. Recovery: stop that fix and name the batch in the report. Bound: none needed.
- **The as2-fast dispatch needs credentials, a ruleset change or a verified-ref publish the lane can't do.** It surfaces as a gh/Actions refusal. Recovery: a question to Jo naming the exact step and owner. Bound: one question.
- **The full suite hangs** (the known Bun.spawnSync git hang on full runs). It surfaces in lane_full_test as an error. Recovery: rerun once; if it hangs again, report it with the run id. Bound: 2 reruns.
- **A profile config rewrite suspends this lane's extensions** (the lane-stop bug still open in its own workload). It surfaces as the lane dying with open work. Recovery: relaunch on Jo's word. Bound: Jo decides.
